### Every problem found, with the reason
Pick a **customer**, **waste company** or **problem** at the top. Each row is one lift or invoice line that looks wrong, *why* we think so, and the euros involved.
It is a **difference to check, not an accusation** — the cause can also be a sensor or missing data.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE label_family WHEN 'COST_PER_T_HIGH' THEN 'Very high cost per tonne' WHEN 'PREMATURE_UNJUSTIFIED' THEN 'Emptied too early' WHEN 'DELAYED_COLLECTION' THEN 'Emptied too late (overflow risk)' WHEN 'WEIGHT_DISCREPANCY' THEN 'Our scale and truck scale disagree' WHEN 'CONTAMINATION_VALUE_LOSS' THEN 'Dirty load lost its value' WHEN 'REJECTED_LOAD' THEN 'Load rejected' WHEN 'OUTDATED_TARIFF' THEN 'Old price on invoice' WHEN 'DUPLICATE_LINE' THEN 'Charged twice' WHEN 'WRONG_SURCHARGE' THEN 'Wrong extra fee' WHEN 'WEIGHT_BASIS_MISMATCH' THEN 'Invoice tonnes differ from truck scale' WHEN 'UNMATCHED_LINE' THEN 'Charge without a lift' WHEN 'MISSING_LINE' THEN 'Charge or credit missing' WHEN 'UNINVOICED_COLLECTION' THEN 'Lift never invoiced' ELSE label_family END AS "Problem", count(*) AS "Count" FROM cp_flags WHERE customer_name IN ($customer) AND operator_name IN ($operator) AND label_family IN ($problem) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Problems, biggest euros first (click a column header to sort)

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(found_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Date", customer_name AS "Customer", CASE label_family WHEN 'COST_PER_T_HIGH' THEN 'Very high cost per tonne' WHEN 'PREMATURE_UNJUSTIFIED' THEN 'Emptied too early' WHEN 'DELAYED_COLLECTION' THEN 'Emptied too late (overflow risk)' WHEN 'WEIGHT_DISCREPANCY' THEN 'Our scale and truck scale disagree' WHEN 'CONTAMINATION_VALUE_LOSS' THEN 'Dirty load lost its value' WHEN 'REJECTED_LOAD' THEN 'Load rejected' WHEN 'OUTDATED_TARIFF' THEN 'Old price on invoice' WHEN 'DUPLICATE_LINE' THEN 'Charged twice' WHEN 'WRONG_SURCHARGE' THEN 'Wrong extra fee' WHEN 'WEIGHT_BASIS_MISMATCH' THEN 'Invoice tonnes differ from truck scale' WHEN 'UNMATCHED_LINE' THEN 'Charge without a lift' WHEN 'MISSING_LINE' THEN 'Charge or credit missing' WHEN 'UNINVOICED_COLLECTION' THEN 'Lift never invoiced' ELSE label_family END AS "Problem", evidence AS "What the data shows", eur_at_stake AS "Euros", entity_id AS "Record" FROM cp_flags WHERE customer_name IN ($customer) AND operator_name IN ($operator) AND label_family IN ($problem) AND $__timeFilter(found_at) ORDER BY eur_at_stake DESC NULLS LAST, found_at DESC LIMIT 1000

SELECT date_trunc('month', found_at) AS "time", count(*) AS "problems" FROM cp_flags WHERE customer_name IN ($customer) AND operator_name IN ($operator) AND label_family IN ($problem) AND $__timeFilter(found_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
